rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (2 tracks) per https://musicbrainz.org/release/08f7a2ef-23cc-4e8b-8862-a296fd1c2bf0, https://grokipedia.com/page/Ed_Sheeran_discography. CORRECTION vs. the briefing hint: this is NOT 'Shape of You' + 'Perfect'. The 7 June 2017 Spotify Singles release (Asylum, barcode 190295783211, recorded at Spotify Studios NYC) is a 2-track EP: a piano version of 'Castle on the Hill' and a Britney Spears cover of '...Baby One More Time'. MusicBrainz order corroborated by grokipedia ('Castle on the Hill' piano version + '...Baby One More Time' Britney cover) and rclyricsband (both tracks listed under 'Spotify Singles').
